_instructions: TEMPLATE — fill in per project, or let the skills populate it. The pattern skills (smart-context, backend-patterns, frontend-patterns, architecture-scanner) auto-detect stack and paths on first scan; this file holds the conventions and config that CANNOT be detected by scanning (business rules, agreed conventions, limits).

conventions._note: Document project-specific conventions Claude must always apply, e.g. soft-delete approach, entity tracking rules, required default values. Delete this key if none.

paths._note: Optional: key source roots. Skills auto-detect these on first scan; only fill in if detection needs overriding.

git._note: Used by the branch-sync skill / branch-syncer agent. baseBranch: the branch PRs target and that gets merged INTO feature branches before a PR. syncStrategy: merge (default) or rebase, per team policy.
